Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to extract the critical "Production country" information from the visible Wikipedia search results in Step 4. The search results explicitly listed the French Wikipedia page (fr.wikipedia.org › wiki › Dans_ma_peau) and the Russian Wikipedia page, both of which clearly identify the film as French (the Russian snippet even translates the title as "French film"). Additionally, the English Wikipedia snippet describes it as a "2002 New French Extremity horror film." Despite these clear indicators of the film's origin, the WebSurfer did not report this finding and instead repeated the same search query multiple times without synthesizing the available data to conclude that the film is from France, leading to a failure to confirm the answer.
